subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank.

The mechanics tried a lot to get that car _________ from the accident spot.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"towed"** means to pull a vehicle or boat by attaching it to another vehicle or boat. (खींचना)

 
 
• **Example: **The broken-down car was** towed** to the nearest garage.
 
 
 
• **"Toad"** refers to a small, squat amphibian similar to a frog. (मेंढ़क)
 
 
• **Example: **We saw a** toad** hopping across the path during our hike.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the correct word to fill in the blank is **'towed'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Toad** (मेंढ़क): A small, squat amphibian similar to a frog.

 
 
• **Example:** We saw a** toad** hopping across the path during our hike.
 
 
 
• **Toed** (अंगुलियों वाला): Having toes of a specified kind or number.
 
 
• **Example:** The three-**toed **sloth moves very slowly.
 
 
 
• **Told** (कहा): Past tense of tell; to have communicated information to someone.
 
 
• **Example:** She **told **me the story of her adventurous trip.
